description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - The Electricity (Dispute Resolution Procedure) Rules
reasoning: This gazette content contains rules made by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, establishing dispute resolution procedures for electricity-related matters. This constitutes regulatory framework and compliance requirements, falling under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories, but rather establishes legal procedures for resolving disputes between licensees and customers in the electricity sector.
